forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Move the GraphQL layer to the Extras toolkit and drop the GraphQL/Graphiti pins
+---
+## What
+Replace the kanban copies of toolkit parts with the FoundationModelsExtras GraphQL toolkit (main 6670bc0), per EXTRAS-9 rule 2 and D74/D86. Spec: TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-kanban.md KANBAN-5 (paragraph 2), foundationmodels-extras.md EXTRAS-6/EXTRAS-9.
+
+Delete these copies and use the Extras versions:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/GraphQL/CodedError.swift` → Extras `CodedError` (the kanban error enum stays and conforms to the Extras protocol)
+- `ResponseWarnings.swift`, `NameRewrite.swift` (NameRewrite/DocumentRewriter), `NameMatcher.swift`, `VariableReads.swift`, `JSONListText.swift`
+- the DateTime/JSON scalars in `Scalars.swift` → `addToolkitScalars()`
+- the kanban subscription refusal in `KanbanTool` → `GraphQLToolkitError.subscriptionNotInTool` through `GraphQLTool.answer`
+- the run/response code in `Tool/KanbanGraph.swift` (`execute`, `subscribe`, the response type near line 1442) → `GraphQLRunContext`, `respond`, `subscribe`
+- `FieldAliases.swift` alias tables are fed to `GraphQLNameRules`, so rewrites still show in `extensions.rewrites`
+
+Kanban-only parts stay: `RemovedParameters.swift` (old Rust parameter compat), the board schema and resolvers, the alias tables, the `board { … }` root container, `extensions.txn`, `extensions.warnings` content.
+
+Package.swift: remove the `GraphQL` and `Graphiti` package pins and products from the library and test targets.
+
+## Blocker to check first
+57 files `import GraphQL`/`import Graphiti`. SwiftPM cannot link a product of a package that the manifest does not declare, and Extras today does not `@_exported import GraphQL`/`Graphiti`. Either Extras re-exports them (from FoundationModelsExtras or a GraphQL product), or kanban cannot drop the pins. Coordinated with foundationmodelsmultitool-bc; do not work around it locally.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No file under Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/GraphQL duplicates a toolkit type (CodedError protocol, ResponseWarnings, NameRewrite, DocumentRewriter, NameMatcher, VariableReads, JSONListText, DateTime/JSON scalars)
+- [ ] Package.swift has no GraphQL or Graphiti package dependency
+- [ ] Alias names still rewrite and show in `extensions.rewrites`; old Rust parameter names still work
+- [ ] `extensions.txn` and `extensions.warnings` unchanged for existing calls
+- [ ] A subscription through KanbanTool gives `SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_IN_TOOL` with a hint naming the query to read again (rule 10)
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Full existing suite green (`swift test`), no response JSON drift except intentional ones listed in the commit
+- [ ] Existing alias/rewrite, warnings, and Rust-compat tests pass unchanged #graphql-endpoint #D115
\ No newline at end of file
